item.name: Get list of transactions for a publisher

request.name: Get list of transactions for a publisher

description.content: Pull individual transactions for a publisher over a date range of up to 31 days. Times use the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss format in the given timezone.

query.description: (Required) User-level access token (also accepted as an Authorization Bearer header).
(Required) Start of range, format yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss. Max 31 days between start and end.
(Required) End of range, format yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss. Max 31 days between start and end.
(Required) Timezone identifier, e.g. UTC, Europe/London, US/Eastern.
Which date to filter transactions on.
Include basket products when product-level tracking is enabled.
Single advertiser ID or comma-separated list.

response.name: OK

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

description.content:
Documented public REST API for the Awin global affiliate marketing network. Publishers and advertisers pull individual transactions and aggregated performance reports, read commission groups and programme details, and list the accounts a user can access. All endpoints are served over HTTPS only, return JSON, and authenticate with an OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token issued at the user level from the Awin UI. A platform throttle limits usage to 20 API calls per minute per user. Endpoints and parameters below are grounded in the public Awin API documentation at help.awin.com/apidocs.
